high_level_description: The image is a screenshot of an article from Inc42, a publication focused on India's tech and startup economy. The top section of the screen shows the Inc42 logo prominently displayed in white against a red background. Below the logo, there is a header that reads "India's Tech & Startup Economy," indicating the topic of the article. The main content of the article discusses the current state of the Indian startup ecosystem. It mentions that despite the ongoing funding challenges, only two unicorns (startups valued at $1 billion or more) were minted last year—Zepto and InCred.
